[[Smuggler]] may refer to either one of the following collectors in the [[Command Post]], each with a different profession:
*{{r}} 15 (20) [[Smuggler (ranger)]] (collector for 5 [[Kournan Coin]]s)
*{{mo}} 15 (20) [[Smuggler (monk)]] (collector for 3 [[Kournan Coin]]s)
*{{me}} 14 (20) [[Smuggler (mesmer)]] (collector for 1 [[Kournan Coin]])
